note: One line per photograph: Maat's (Fable 5.1) lines from review/new-sets-lines-maat-2026-10-07.json, ruled by Al (7-8 Oct 2026) — they replace Vonk's two candidates. candidates.en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
candidates.af: Die hele veld met die kleur afgedraai. Die skape tel dieselfde, hoe ook al.

findings: dieselfde (low): 'dieselfde' means 'same; similarly' — nothing in the English source; the source's 'whole' would normally be 'gaaf' / 'geheel' / 'heel', none present

candidates.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
candidates.af: Nie een skaduwee op die veld die hele dag nie. Die skeidsregter het nie een keer sy oë op skrefies getrek nie.

candidates.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
candidates.af: Grys lug, truie aan, skool is uit. Die naweek vra nie die son se toestemming nie.

findings: lug (low): 'lug' means 'air' — nothing in the English source; the source's 'sky' would normally be 'hemel', none present
vra (low): 'vra' means 'ask; asks' — nothing in the English source; the source's 'sky' would normally be 'hemel', none present

candidates.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
candidates.af: Die lug het van liggrys na donkergrys gegaan. Dit was die hele vertoning.

findings: lug (medium): 'lug' means 'air' — nothing in the English source; it is 1 letter from 'lig', the usual word for 'light'

gegaan (low): 'gegaan' means 'past participle of gaan; to go; Used to express the future tense, often while implying nearness in time or certainty, like English going to.' — nothing in the English source; the source's 'sky' would normally be 'hemel', none present

candidates.en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
candidates.af: Die sekuriteitslig het vroeg aangegaan. Die son het nooit behoorlik ingeklok nie.

findings: aangegaan (low): 'aangegaan' means 'to concern; to be a concern to; to be someone’s business; to start; to turn on; to continue; to go on' — nothing in the English source; the source's 'light' would normally be 'lig' / 'verlig' / 'vuurtoring' / 'opsteek', none present

candidates.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
candidates.af: See en lug in bypassende grys. Net die pier se liggies het moeite gedoen.

findings: lug (medium): 'lug' means 'air' — nothing in the English source; it is 1 letter from 'lig', the usual word for 'lights'

gedoen (low): 'gedoen' means 'past participle of doen; to do; does' — nothing in the English source; the source's 'sky' would normally be 'hemel', none present — but it does co-occur in corpus with 'moeite'

candidates.en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
candidates.af: Die skuur se gloeilamp is vanaand se sonsondergang. Die beeste aanvaar die afgradering.
